chat.welcomeMessage: Wedding Manager v32.2.0 — Hebrew RTL · ES2025 · Vite 8 · 6803 tests · 482 files · 9 agents · 0 lint · CI green

instructions: Verify no innerHTML with unsanitized data — textContent or sanitize() only.
All visible strings must use data-i18n='key' (HTML) or t('key') (JS) — both he+en required.
Confirm all colors use CSS custom properties — no hardcoded hex/rgb.
Sheets writes must use enqueueWrite() — never call syncStoreKeyToSheets directly.
Auth gate: isApprovedAdmin(email) is the single source of truth for admin access.
All localStorage keys must use the wedding_v1_ prefix.
Section modules must export mount(), unmount(), and at least one render*() function.
New runtime dependencies must be justified by an ADR — current count is 4, target ceiling is 6.
New utility files in src/utils/ must have @module and @owner JSDoc tags and a matching test file.
Prefer pure functions with no side-effects in src/utils/ — no DOM, no store, no network.
AI proxy calls must use callAiProxy() from src/services/ai-proxy.js — never fetch AI APIs directly from sections.
Floor plan presets must use the string literals 'banquet' | 'classroom' | 'cocktail' — no magic strings.
Vendor workflow actions (startVendorNegotiation, submitVendorOffer, generatePaymentSchedule) must only be called from handlers layer.
CF Worker (worker/) code must not import from src/ — it is a separate Cloudflare Workers bundle.
New data-action attributes in templates must have a matching on() registration in src/handlers/.
